question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series, will complete the series.

_KL_K_KK_ _KL
solution:
**Given :** _KL_K_KK_ _KL

By checking options :

 
• KKLLK → __**K**__KL__**K**__K__**L**__KK__**L**__ __**K**__KL → (It follows the pattern of : KKL - KKL - KKL - KKL)
 
• LLKLL → __L__KL<span style="font-weight: bolder;&q
